steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Foundation myths (aetiological myths) explained how cities, customs and natural features came to exist | Key Fact: Cadmus founded Thebes after following a cow to its resting place and sowing dragon's teeth to create warriors | Key Fact: Theseus was the legendary founder of Athens who united Attica (synoecism) and slew the Minotaur | Key Fact: Romulus and Remus founded Rome after being suckled by a she-wolf — Romulus killed Remus over the city walls
